page_title: LIV 3-0 AST | Liverpool v Aston Villa 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Liverpool are ruled offside.

90+2' A big opportunity is wasted by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, Emiliano Martinez pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
90+1' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Simon Hooper who sees an offensive foul.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
87' Here comes a substitution. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Alexis Mac Allister.
87' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is caught offside!
84' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jhon Duran.
82' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post.
76' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) receives a defence-splitting pass from Nicolo Zaniolo and shoots early from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes well wide of the left post.
76' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

75' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

74' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the top left corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Emiliano Martinez, who keeps it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
73' Here is a change. Ollie Watkins is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
72' Here comes a substitution. Douglas Luiz is given a rest as he is replaced by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
72' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
72' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
71' Substitution. Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) in, Trent Alexander-Arnold out.
71' The injury to Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
71' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!

69' Joel Matip (Liverpool) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
65' It will be a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is ready to enter the pitch as Leon Bailey walks off.
65' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) replacing Darwin Nunez.
65' Substitution. Diogo Jota (Liverpool) replaces Luis Diaz.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Curtis Jones.

63' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the right side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
63' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

62' John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Alisson. This effort really didn't trouble him.
59' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sends a long ball forward to Ollie Watkins, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
58' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) jumps into a tackle and Simon Hooper signals a foul. Aston Villa have a free kick from a promising distance.
55' 3 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Darwin Nunez knock down. 3:0.
54' Corner kick. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is ready to send the ball into the box.

54' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Referee Simon Hooper sees the trip by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
49' Mohamed Salah swings the cross over. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post.
49' Lucas Digne plays a nice corner into the middle of the box, Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is first to react but his headed effort is way off the mark and goes well wide of the left post.
49' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

48' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alisson shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Aston Villa are going to take it.
47' Simon Hooper blows his whistle after Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. That's a free kick to Aston Villa.

47' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
46' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but Emiliano Martinez is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

43' What a chance that is! Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
42' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
41' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
39' OFF THE BAR! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.
38' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the left post.
36' 5:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
34' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player.
33' CHANCE! John McGinn (Aston Villa) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Moussa Diaby.
31' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
31' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Now Aston Villa have a corner.
30' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) attempts to feed Curtis Jones with a chip pass, but Emiliano Martinez reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
27' Joel Matip (Liverpool) latches onto the free kick from Trent Alexander-Arnold, but heads just wide of the right post from close range.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Simon Hooper didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' No offside! Referee Simon Hooper points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Liverpool players.
23' The Liverpool players halt their celebrations as referee Simon Hooper makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
22' 2 - 0 Matty Cash (Aston Villa) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
22' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the right post.
20' John McGinn (Aston Villa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Simon Hooper stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick to Liverpool.
19' Diego Carlos is being substituted because of an injury. Unai Emery sends Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) on the pitch.
19' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
17' The game is interrupted now, Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

16' A pass lands at the feet of Luis Diaz (Liverpool) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) tries to find Ollie Watkins, but he puts too much power on the pass.
10' The foul by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) was seen by Simon Hooper who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
8' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
7' Liverpool hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

3' 1 - 0 The ball hits the back of the net! Trent Alexander-Arnold delivers the corner, Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes inside the right post and past the helpless goalkeeper. 1:0.
3' Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The match has just started.
Aston Villa will kick-off.
Simon Hooper is the one to supervise the game today.
